sentence: This project builds a way to network small quantum processors and use entanglement so quantum computers can correct errors without long-range interactions.
This project studies how leaky sewer pipes and the soil around them change the way water moves above and below ground in urban watersheds.
This project builds mathematical and computer tools that reveal the hidden processes controlling how living cells move, using only limited experimental observations.
This project builds string-like soft robots that can move alone or tangle together to carry objects as a group, inspired by blackworms.
This project designs shape memory polymers that can change shape in both directions and lift large loads, using nanostructures that form when the material is stretched.
This project tries to find out how to control the swirling flows made by swimming bacteria, by tuning single bacteria and guiding the whole group.
This project builds a device that uses a nanopore to count single molecules, so nucleic acids can be tested for at the point of care.
This project studies ways to create entanglement between more than two qubits at once, to shorten quantum circuits on limited quantum hardware.
This project builds a way for a person and a robot to share control of robotic arms, with the robot avoiding obstacles and coping with joint failures.
This project works on charging stations and electrified roadways so electric vehicles can travel far and charge reliably, and links transportation with the electric utility network.
This project tries to find out why two ways of measuring the size of the proton disagree, using muon and electron scattering data.
This project gets a two-photon microscope that lets researchers study large groups of brain cells in primates during complex cognition.
This project uses algebra to build machine learning methods that are more accurate, handle large data sets better and give results that are easier to interpret.
This project builds a statewide research network around forests, including cellulosic nanofiber products and AI technologies that assess ecosystems.
This project designs springs and motors together for humanoid robots so they use less energy and can move well and safely near humans.
This project builds a way for underwater robots to work out where they are using light and on-board AI, without coming up to the surface.
